name: co-work
description: General work and task execution workflow variant for research, documentation, and project coordination. Includes specialized collaboration agents covering analysis, content writing, technical writing, project coordination, and MS365 integration. Includes the native PPTX deck capability (spec 2026-11-03-co-work-native-pptx-deck-design, export tier rebased onto ppt-master per design 2026-11-06-deck-emitter-ppt-master-rebase-design): deck-builder agent authors per-page canonical SVG under deterministic quality gates (python svg_check.py) and exports natively editable DrawingML via ppt-master-adapter.ts + the ppt-master chain.

agent_manifest.notes: ms365-expert: only when MS365 tooling (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Teams) is required. storyteller: skip for purely technical or operational work. deck-builder: only when a native PPTX deck deliverable is requested (content from content-writer/storyteller).

spawn_target_externals.provided_by: ppt-master pinned clone v6.8.0 (MIT) per project external-deps.json (id ppt-master, install_dir external/ppt-master): run-chain.sh resolves PM_SCRIPTS to <clone>/skills/ppt-master/scripts (ppt-master-adapter.ts:208,342); clone delivery is delegated to the external-deps machinery (D2 scaffold fetch + D3 compatibility tests, docs/designs/2026-11-07-external-deps-machinery-design.md)
spawn_target_externals.rationale: run-chain.sh spawn literals ($PM_SCRIPTS/*.py) point into the pinned ppt-master clone, which lives outside the template tree by contract — static template-tree existence checking is delegated to D2/D3

spawn_target_externals.provided_by: run-time artifact: PROJ is the ppt-master project dir scaffolded by their project_manager.py (ppt-master-adapter.ts:223-228) and opc_check.py is written into it by ppt-master-adapter.ts itself (writeFileSync join(args.out,'opc_check.py'), line 366) before run-chain.sh executes
spawn_target_externals.rationale: run-chain.sh literal $PROJ/opc_check.py resolves only after the adapter generates the project dir — no static template-tree target can exist

script_manifest.notes: svg_check.py (2.1.0, python 3.10+ stdlib) is the canonical-SVG quality gate and the SINGLE checker since 2026-11-07 — 2.0.0 was the faithful port of svg-check.ts 1.5.x, switched only after tests/test_svg_check_parity.py proved byte-identical fingerprints and identical verdicts over the 100-page main deck, the 12-page exec cut, and the golden fixture (Phase 2 of design 2026-11-06-deck-emitter-ppt-master-rebase-design); 2.1.0 adds exec-cut contract support (the W-CONTENT-UNRENDERED reverse diff active for ## E01–## E12 contracts: section termination at any other markdown heading, structured-field awareness — focal/title/runs content checked, footnote/table/visual blocks structural — and punctuation-insensitive loose matching; ## Page <n> output byte-identical, main fingerprint aa3baf43… unchanged). svg-check.ts was DELETED 2026-11-07 (oracle retirement) after the differential parity run: the harness became the python-only semantics suite tests/test_svg_check.py (real-deck fingerprints aa3baf43… / ffa4d390… pinned; E-contract mutation pin proves the reverse diff). svg-to-pptx.ts was DELETED 2026-11-07: superseded as the export engine by ppt-master-adapter.ts + the ppt-master v6.8.0 (MIT) chain consumed as-is (design D1/D6, DEC-20261106-04); its golden pins were superseded — entity/notes/ID pins live in the python semantics suite, export pins are carried by ppt-master's own validators (pptx_opc_validation.py, pptx_delivery_check.py). render_previews.py (1.0.0) renders white-underlay previews (resvg-py engine, bun+@resvg/resvg-js subprocess fallback) — replaces the retired svg-to-pptx --render-png mode. Deps: python 3.10+ stdlib (gate, semantics suite), resvg-py (previews), fflate + fast-xml-parser (adapter), @resvg/resvg-js (preview fallback). External dep: ppt-master pin v6.8.0 per project external-deps.json (gitignored external/ppt-master/ clone delivered by the external-deps machinery; PyMuPDF/AGPL excluded).
